The five decorators now pass a `Condition` to `cached`, and both MRU APIs are removed. All 193 non-MRU tests pass. The full suite reports eight errors, all from tests that still require the removed APIs.

Additional concurrency checks passed for all five decorators, covering same-key requests, unrelated keys, wakeups before completion, exceptions, cache clearing, and bounded, unbounded, and zero-size caches.
